# The Thriving Project

> The Thriving Quotient family of validated campus survey instruments, created by Dr. Laurie A. Schreiner (Professor Emerita of Higher Education, Azusa Pacific University). Measures college student thriving — the degree to which students are engaged academically, connected interpersonally, and psychologically well — on scales an institution can act on. Sold directly to colleges and universities; licensed to researchers for dissertations and studies.

Site: https://thrivingincollege.org/
Contact and research permissions: lschreiner@thrivingincollege.org · 626-826-6376
Mailing address: Dr. Laurie A. Schreiner, Director, The Thriving Project, 1368 Upland Hills Drive S, Upland, CA 91786
Legal name: Dr. Laurie Schreiner, doing business as The Thriving Project

## What thriving means

Thriving is a fuller measure of student success than persistence or grades alone. Every factor the Thriving Quotient measures is malleable — an institution can move it through its own practice — which is what makes the results actionable. Vocabulary bridge: https://thrivingincollege.org/thriving-vs-engagement-retention-belonging/

## Instruments (one per campus population; all administered the same way; all priced the same)

- Undergraduate Thriving Quotient: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/undergraduate/ — five scales: Engaged Learning, Academic Determination, Positive Perspective, Diverse Citizenship, Social Connectedness
- Sophomore Experiences Survey: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/sophomore/
- Adult Thriving Quotient: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/adult-learner/
- Graduate Student Thriving Quotient: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/graduate/
- Community College Thriving Quotient: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/community-college/
- Faculty Thriving Quotient (an Adjunct Faculty variant is chosen at checkout): https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/faculty/
- Staff Thriving Quotient: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/staff/
- All seven compared: https://thrivingincollege.org/instruments/

## Packages and prices (USD, 2026–27; one canonical list)

- Survey Package — $750 per survey. Survey setup, the link, raw data returned at close. No report, no dashboard. https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/survey/
- Basic Report Package — $1,500 per survey. Adds a national-norms comparison report and an interactive dashboard (gender, race/ethnicity). https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/basic-report/
- Expanded Report Package — $2,500 per survey. Administered from your email list; up to 10 institution-specific questions; norms report; dashboard; predictive model for your campus when more than 300 responses are returned. https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/expanded-report/
- Thriving Campus Package with One-Hour Webinar — $10,000. Any five instruments within one year, up to 10 institution-specific questions each, norms reports, predictive models (>300 responses), dashboards, plus a one-hour webinar with Dr. Schreiner. https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/thriving-campus/
- Researcher Option — $250, proposal first. Use of an instrument (and, for dissertation students, a dataset) in a study. https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/researcher/
- Add-ons: additional institution-specific questions $300 per group of five; additional demographic variable in the dashboard $300 per variable; standalone one-hour webinar with Dr. Schreiner $2,000.
- Discount: 15% off when three or more survey packages (Survey, Basic Report, Expanded Report, any combination) are in one order. Never applies to the Thriving Campus package, add-ons or the webinar.
- Compare: https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/ · Buy: https://thrivingincollege.org/store/ · Invoice / purchase order (Net 30, ACH or card): https://thrivingincollege.org/packages/request-invoice/

## How to begin

1. Choose the instrument for the population you are surveying.
2. Order a package at https://thrivingincollege.org/store/ (card or US bank debit) or request an invoice for a purchase order.
3. Your campus receives a survey link to distribute (or, on the Expanded package, The Thriving Project administers it from your email list). Responses return directly to The Thriving Project; reporting follows when the window closes.

## How to license the instrument for research

Submit a proposal with the researcher request form at https://thrivingincollege.org/for-researchers/. When Dr. Schreiner returns the signed proposal, the $250 licence is paid and the instrument is released with written permission. Dissertations that used the Thriving Quotient: https://thrivingincollege.org/research/dissertations/
